title: How is one thousand and five tenths written with a comma?
description: The number one thousand and five tenths is written in the point notation and then in the comma notation, where the comma marks the tenths and a space marks the thousands. A small example shows why the notation must be checked. Keeko's doubt keeps the comma for thousands.
teaching_notes: One idea: in the comma notation the comma is the decimal mark and a space separates the thousands. Watch for students who keep the comma in the thousands place and mix the two notations.

source: In a country that uses the comma, how would a number such a
video_script.why: The child has met the decimal point and now sees that some countries write the decimal mark as a comma.
video_script.substitution: Write the number in the point notation, then swap the roles of the comma and the point as the other notation asks.
video_script.anchor: A number written one way in one country and another way in another country.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeps the comma between the thousands and the rest and does not use it for the tenths, so the two notations are mixed together.
video_script.payoff_line: Check which notation is in use before you read a number

final_answer.value: 1 000,5 in the comma notation, and the notation must be checked
final_answer.spoken: one space zero zero zero comma five in the comma notation, and the notation must be checked

hold_back: 1 000,5 in the comma notation, and the notation must be checked
maths_rules: point notation: 1,000.5 has a comma between the thousands and a point before the tenths
comma notation: the space takes the place of the thousand separator and the comma is the decimal mark, so it is 1 000,5
the same marks 1,500 mean one thousand five hundred in the point notation and 1.5 in the comma notation
the slip: writing the comma between 1 and 000 keeps the old thousand separator, which mixes the notations
video_script.design: The number is built place by place on a board and written first in the point notation. The comma and the point then swap roles to give the comma notation. A second number, one comma five zero zero, is read both ways to show the two meanings.
